races.paceDynamic: That Is Blue will set a steady gallop from the front with Pigeon Forge tracking close behind, creating a sustainable pace without early pressure. The modest field size and lack of confirmed pace-pressers means the tempo will be manageable through the middle stages. Eremenko and Approaching Storm will settle at the back, relying on late kicks to reel in the leaders. This setup favours prominent racers who can stay close to the pace and kick clear when the hold-up horses are still getting organized.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If That Is Blue maintains her jumping rhythm and isn't pressured early
scenarios.body: The pace stays honest but not fierce, allowing her to build an unassailable lead before the hold-up horses can mount their challenge. Her recent Hereford third suggests she's ready to go one better with cleaner jumping.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace proves too slow and bunches the field
scenarios.body: Eremenko's class tells as she sweeps past tiring leaders, with her Nicky Henderson polish and recent Windsor win providing the ammunition for a decisive late strike. The hold-up brigade gets the run of the race they need.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If That Is Blue makes jumping errors or weakens approaching the last
scenarios.body: Pigeon Forge capitalizes on her position just behind the leader, having tracked the pace without doing too much work early. Her Emma Lavelle conditioning gives her the stamina edge in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If That Is Blue goes too slowly and all five horses are in contention turning in
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where Approaching Storm's tendency to fade works against her despite being in the right position. Risk De Cerisy's unknown stamina becomes the decisive factor.

races.paceDynamic: Ballyfinn will dictate terms from the front in this small field, with his prominent style making him the natural pace-setter over this staying trip. Sweet Nightingale, Delgany Deadline and Milan Milos all prefer to hold up, meaning Ballyfinn faces minimal early pressure and can control the gallop. The lack of pace pressure should allow Ballyfinn to string out the field and kick for home when it matters. This race shape strongly favours the front runner and prominent racers who can stay close to the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Ballyfinn Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Ballyfinn gets an uncontested lead and sustains his galloping rhythm
scenarios.body: He can dictate ideal fractions and has the stamina to repel late challenges from hold-up horses over this extended trip. The combination of controlled pace and tactical advantage makes him extremely hard to peg back.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly crawling and the hold-up horses get perfect cover
scenarios.body: Sweet Nightingale or Delgany Deadline can unleash devastating late kicks when the race opens up in the final half-mile. Their superior turn of foot overcomes the tactical disadvantage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Ballyfinn Folds Late
scenarios.trigger: If Ballyfinn's 18-day break tells and he ties up in the closing stages
scenarios.body: His early advantage evaporates as fresher legs sweep past, with Sweet Nightingale's recent winning form proving decisive. The 3m1½f trip becomes a stamina test he cannot answer.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Upset From Behind
scenarios.trigger: If Milan Milos gets the run of the race and benefits from a strong pace collapse
scenarios.body: His light weight and 23-day freshening allows him to pick up the pieces when the principals falter. The class horses underperform and he sneaks through at rewarding odds.

With six hold-up horses including Goodwin Face, Dream's Ka, and Pottersmattyeeehaa waiting to pounce, this sets up as a moderate early pace followed by a sustained drive from the final hurdle. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can capitalize on the lack of early pace and finish strongly when the race develops.

scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Shalfa maintains her usual front-running role without serious early pressure
scenarios.body: The moderate early pace allows the large contingent of hold-up horses to conserve energy and time their runs perfectly from off the pace. Goodwin Face, Dream's Ka, and Pottersmattyeeehaa can all unleash finishing kicks when it matters most.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Definite and Voix De Bocelli track Shalfa closely and kick clear approaching the final hurdle
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get first run on the field before the hold-up horses can organize their challenges. Their tactical positioning proves decisive as they avoid the late traffic that could hinder the back-runners.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Shalfa Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and Shalfa maintains a strong rhythm throughout
scenarios.body: The front runner capitalizes on weak early fractions to establish an unassailable lead, holding off late challenges through superior fitness. Her 39-day break and previous course form at this distance becomes the deciding factor.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If the race becomes a messy, stop-start affair with multiple pace changes
scenarios.body: The unconventional running of Pink 'n Purple or a resurgent Ballybay catches the field napping as the favorites fail to handle the tactical complications. Fresh legs and light weights become crucial advantages in a scrambled finish.

races.paceDynamic: Inca De Lafayette will take the field along as the sole confirmed front runner, setting a controlled gallop that won't stretch this small field early. This race shape clearly favours prominent racers and hold-up horses who can produce a sustained finish, as the measured early tempo will leave plenty in reserve for those who time their challenge correctly.

scenarios.label: C
